displayDescription: Editorial spread on cool drafting stock: a vermilion spark moves into the figure grid and becomes a network as the headline and columns reveal in reading order.
motionEngine: Motion (motion@14 interpolate/mix/cubicBezier/backOut, bundled locally to motion-utils.js)
GSAP paused timeline as the seekable composition clock
limitations: Flat procedural print look: the drafting grid and hatching are vector approximations of paper stock, with no real paper texture or lighting.
System fonts (Georgia, Helvetica Neue/Arial) are measured at load time with canvas measureText; metrics vary slightly between platforms.
A 3 s preview leaves only a brief settled hold for the body copy.
